description: This file contains implementation of PHY-related functions for the RTL8367C switch, including functions to set and get PHY OCP registers, PHY registers, and Serdes (SDS) registers, with specific hardware register access logic.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 ocpData)
methods.description: Sets PHY OCP registers at a specific address for a given PHY port. Implements hardware register writes with address preparation and write command.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Retrieves PHY OCP register data for a given PHY port and OCP address, with hardware register read.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 phyData)
methods.description: Sets PHY registers based on PHY address and port, internally translating to OCP register access.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Gets PHY register data based on PHY address and port, via OCP register read.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 value)
methods.description: Writes data to a specified Serdes (SDS) register, page, and ID.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 * value)
methods.description: Reads data from a specified Serdes (SDS) register, page, and ID, with busy waiting.
